description: This PHP source file defines the class ViewConfiguretabs, which handles the rendering of the configuration interface for managing organizational tabs within the SuiteCRM administration module. It includes methods to generate the module title, enforce access control, and display the configuration page with enabled and disabled tabs, subpanel panels, and their respective data prepared for front-end rendering.

classes.name: ViewConfiguretabs
classes.description: A controller class for rendering the 'configure tabs' view in the SuiteCRM administration module, managing tab enablement, subpanels, and access control.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the HTML links and titles for the module page header, with module name and current section title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has administrative privileges; terminates execution if not authorized.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data and context for the configuration view, including enabled/disabled tabs and subpanel panels, and renders the template.
